description: This file implements a PHP class named GDPR within the OpenCart admin module. It handles GDPR-related functionalities such as listing GDPR requests, approving, denying, and deleting GDPR records, including filtering, pagination, and permission checks.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class managing GDPR-related administrative actions such as listing GDPR requests, approving, denying, and deleting them, with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to render the GDPR management page including setup of breadcrumbs, page title, and view rendering.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of GDPR requests, applies filters, pagination, and prepares data for view rendering.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves filtered GDPR request data with pagination and sorting, returning an HTML view for the GDPR list.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Processes approval of selected GDPR requests, updating statuses and returning success/error JSON response.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Processes denial of GDPR requests, updating statuses accordingly and returning a JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected GDPR requests, with permission checks and JSON response.
